_comment: Codex hooks. Install to .codex/hooks.json (NOT .codex/hooks/hooks.json - Codex does not read that path). The scripts referenced below install to .codex/hooks/scripts/. Codex exposes 11 lifecycle events whose names are identical to Claude Code's: SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact, PostCompact, SubagentStart, SubagentStop. Only type=command executes today - prompt and agent handlers are parsed then skipped, so none is shipped here. Reference: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks
_install: mkdir -p .codex/hooks/scripts && cp runtimes/.codex/hooks/hooks.template.json .codex/hooks.json && cp runtimes/.codex/hooks/scripts/*.sh .codex/hooks/scripts/ && chmod +x .codex/hooks/scripts/*.sh
_matchers: Every entry below matches universally (matcher ""). That is deliberate: a matcher is a regex over the tool name, tool names differ between Codex releases, and a matcher that fails to match is a silent hole rather than a loud failure. Each script re-filters its own payload, which is testable from the shell. Narrow these only after confirming the tool names your Codex build actually emits.
